main_body: T-shaped wooden timber prop (horizontal crossbeam supported by a central vertical post)
top_band: Light tan/ochre top surface of the horizontal crossbeam at rows 10-12 (under a 1px dark brown outline at row 9), followed by a 1px bright cream front-edge highlight at row 13
evidence: Reading down the middle column: row 9 is the top outline, rows 10-12 form a 3px light tan top plane, and row 13 is a distinct 1px cream front-edge highlight (4 top rows total). Rows 14-17 are the darker brown vertical front face of the crossbeam, and rows 18-47 are the vertical support post set back underneath with an eave shadow at rows 18-19.

style.evidence: The wood material uses 6 distinct value steps (cream highlight, light tan, mid tan, medium brown, dark brown, deep brown outline/shadow). Outlines are a warm dark brown material tone, and both the top beam and vertical post feature varied wood grain dots and joint banding without flat fills.
